items.exampleEn: The brand opened its first outlet in Taichung last year.
items.exampleZh: 這個品牌去年在台中開了第一家暢貨店。

items.exampleEn: Each packet of flower seeds costs fifty dollars.
items.exampleZh: 每一小包花的種子賣五十元。

items.exampleEn: It took three hours to unload the ship.
items.exampleZh: 卸下那艘船的貨花了三個小時。

items.exampleEn: The shop keeps a large stock of winter coats.
items.exampleZh: 那家店備有大量冬季外套的庫存。

items.exampleEn: Please keep your receipt in case you want to return your purchase.
items.exampleZh: 請保留收據，以免您想退回所購買的商品。

items.exampleEn: Imported cheese is quite expensive here.
items.exampleZh: 進口起司在這裡相當貴。

items.exampleEn: The restaurant changed its fish supplier last month.
items.exampleZh: 那家餐廳上個月換了魚貨供應商。

items.exampleEn: The company pays extra for faster shipping.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司多付錢，讓貨送得更快。

items.sentenceEn: Workers unload the trucks at the back of the supermarket every morning.
items.sentenceZh: 工人每天早上在超市後面卸貨。

items.audioEn: Sorry, that jacket is out of stock in your size, but we can order one for you.
items.audioZh: 抱歉，那件夾克您的尺寸已經沒貨了，但我們可以幫您訂一件。
items.questionZh: 店員說那件夾克怎麼了？

items.sentenceEn: The country imports more oil than any other product.
items.sentenceZh: 這個國家進口最多的產品是石油。

items.sentenceEn: Shipping is free for orders over one thousand dollars.
items.sentenceZh: 訂單超過一千元就免運費。

items.stemEn: Our main ____ of paper raised its prices, so we are looking for a cheaper one.
items.stemZh: 我們主要的紙張供應商漲價了，所以我們正在找比較便宜的。

items.stemEn: You can ____ tickets from the machine at the station.
items.stemZh: 你可以在車站的機器購買車票。

items.passageEn: Every Monday, Ms. Su checks the stock in her small kitchen shop. If something is running low, she places an order with her supplier. Most of her pots and knives are imported from Japan, so shipping can take two weeks. Last month, a big order arrived on a Friday evening, and her son helped her unload the boxes. One box was full of small packets of tea, which she had not ordered. When she called the supplier, they told her to keep the tea as a gift. Ms. Su is also thinking of opening a second shop in the new outlet mall near the airport, where customers can make a purchase online and collect it at the shop the same day. She will pay for it with a small loan.
items.passageZh: 每個星期一，蘇小姐都會檢查她那家小廚具店的存貨。如果有東西快賣完了，她就向供應商下訂單。她的鍋子和刀子大多是從日本進口的，所以運送可能要兩個星期。上個月，一批大訂單在星期五晚上送到，她兒子幫她卸下箱子。其中一箱裝滿了小包的茶葉，那是她沒有訂的。她打電話給供應商，對方說茶葉就留著當禮物。蘇小姐也在考慮到機場附近新開的暢貨中心開第二家店，顧客可以在網路上購買，當天到店取貨。她會用一筆小額貸款來支付開店費用。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼運送可能要兩個星期？
options: 供應商只有週五才送貨

questions.questionZh: 那箱沒有訂的茶葉後來怎麼處理？
options: 供應商讓她留著當禮物

items.promptZh: 這是我這個月買過最貴的東西。
referenceEn: This is my most expensive purchase this month.
This is the most expensive purchase I have made this month.
rubricZh: 「買過的東西」要用到 purchase（例如 my most expensive purchase、my biggest purchase 等）
最高級寫法不限（例如 the most expensive、the biggest 等）

items.promptZh: 我在暢貨中心用半價買到這雙跑鞋。
referenceEn: I bought these running shoes at half price at the outlet.
I got these running shoes for half price at an outlet mall.
rubricZh: 「暢貨中心」可寫，例如 outlet、outlet mall 等
「用半價」可寫，例如 at half price、for half price 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 bought、have bought 等）
